name: Viladrau (Spain)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the white eradicated chestnut tree of nine branches of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 17 June 2013 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 6420 of 18 July 2013; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, light blue, with the white eradicated and fruited chestnut tree of nine branches of the arms, 7/9 of the height and 13/27 of the length, at the centre.

features.role: eradicated chestnut tree of nine branches, fruited, 7/9 of the height
